terms.definitionEn: A mapped utility that makes every property in an object type optional.
terms.definitionAr: utility type بتحول كل properties في نوع object لخصائص اختيارية.

terms.definitionEn: A mapped utility that removes optional markers from every property in an object type.
terms.definitionAr: utility type بتشيل علامات الاختيارية من كل properties في نوع object.

terms.definitionEn: A mapped utility that marks every property in an object type as non-reassignable.
terms.definitionAr: utility type بتخلي كل properties في نوع object غير قابلة لإعادة الإسناد.

terms.definitionEn: A utility that constructs an object type from selected properties of another type.
terms.definitionAr: utility type بتبني نوع object من properties مختارة من نوع تاني.

terms.definitionEn: A utility that constructs an object type while excluding selected properties from another type.
terms.definitionAr: utility type بتبني نوع object مع استبعاد properties مختارة من نوع تاني.

terms.definitionEn: A utility that creates an object type with a chosen key set and one value type.
terms.definitionAr: utility type بتعمل نوع object بمجموعة مفاتيح محددة ونوع قيم موحد.

terms.definitionEn: A utility that extracts the result type from a function type.
terms.definitionAr: utility type بتستخرج نوع النتيجة من نوع دالة.

terms.definitionEn: A utility that extracts a function type's inputs as a tuple.
terms.definitionAr: utility type بتستخرج المدخلات الخاصة بنوع الدالة في شكل tuple.

terms.definitionEn: A utility that removes null and undefined from a union type.
terms.definitionAr: utility type بتشيل null وundefined من union type.

terms.definitionEn: A utility that recursively models the value type produced by awaiting a promise-like type.
terms.definitionAr: utility type بتمثل بشكل متكرر نوع القيمة الناتجة من انتظار promise-like type.

terms.definitionEn: A conditional utility that removes union members assignable to a specified type.
terms.definitionAr: utility شرطية بتستبعد أعضاء union القابلة للإسناد لنوع محدد.

terms.definitionEn: A conditional utility that keeps union members assignable to a specified type.
terms.definitionAr: utility شرطية بتحتفظ بأعضاء union القابلة للإسناد لنوع محدد.

questions.question: What does Patch change about User's properties?
options: It makes every property optional
It makes every property required
It removes every property from the object
It converts every property's value to a string
questions.explanation: Partial maps the object type while making each property optional.
questions.explanationAr: Partial بتحول نوع object وبتخلي كل خاصية اختيارية.

questions.question: What happens to optional properties in Settings?
options: They are removed from the resulting type
Their optional markers are removed
Their value types become unknown
They become readonly but stay optional
questions.explanation: Required removes optional modifiers from the properties.
questions.explanationAr: Required بتشيل علامات الاختيارية من الخصائص.

questions.question: What restriction applies through a Snapshot reference?
options: The object is frozen at runtime including all nested values and methods
Every property must be omitted when creating the object value
Properties cannot be reassigned through that typed reference
The resulting type accepts only properties whose values are textual
questions.explanation: Readonly adds a static readonly modifier to each property; it does not freeze at runtime.
questions.explanationAr: Readonly بتضيف قيد ثابت للخصائص، لكنها مش بتجمد الـ object وقت التشغيل.

questions.question: Which properties does Summary contain?
options: Every User property except id and name
Only id, because Pick accepts one key
A new object with all values changed to names
The selected id and name properties
questions.explanation: Pick keeps the listed keys and their original property types.
questions.explanationAr: Pick بتحتفظ بالمفاتيح المذكورة وأنواع خصائصها الأصلية.

questions.question: What does PublicUser exclude?
options: The password property from the resulting object type
All properties whose values are strings, regardless of their keys
The user key from every other object type declared in the program
The optional modifier from password only, while retaining the property
questions.explanation: Omit constructs a type without the specified property keys.
questions.explanationAr: Omit بتعمل نوع من غير مفاتيح الخصائص المحددة.

questions.question: What shape does Scores describe?
options: An array containing exactly two numeric values at consecutive indexes
An object with math and art keys whose values are numbers
A union containing either one key name or a number as its only member
A function mapping number inputs to key strings and returning a result
questions.explanation: Record creates properties for each key in the union, with number values.
questions.explanationAr: Record بتعمل properties لكل مفتاح في الـ union وقيمها number.

questions.question: What type does Output represent?
options: The parameter tuple that callers pass to the function
The function's source text converted into a string value
The declared return type Promise<string>
The awaited promise result type string with its wrapper removed
questions.explanation: ReturnType extracts the declared return type, which here is Promise<string>.
questions.explanationAr: ReturnType بتستخرج نوع الإرجاع المعلن، وهو هنا Promise<string>.

questions.code: type Args = Parameters<(id: number, active: boolean) => void>;
questions.question: What does Args contain?
options: The function's return type as a union
A record mapping parameter names to types
Only the first parameter's number type
A tuple of the function's parameter types
questions.explanation: Parameters represents the declared parameters as a tuple type.
questions.explanationAr: Parameters بتمثل الـ parameters المعلنة كنوع tuple.

questions.question: Which members remain in Value?
options: string only
string and null
null and undefined
All three original members
questions.explanation: NonNullable removes null and undefined from the union.
questions.explanationAr: NonNullable بتشيل null وundefined من الـ union.

questions.code:
type Editable = Partial<{ name: string; age: number }>;
type NameOptional = Editable['name'];
questions.question: Which modifier applies to name in Editable?
options: Optional
Required
Readonly
Private
questions.explanation: Partial makes name optional while preserving its underlying value type.
questions.explanationAr: Partial بتخلي name اختيارية وبتحافظ على نوع قيمتها.

questions.question: What union remains in Available?
options: 'busy'
'ready'
'ready' | 'busy'
never | undefined
questions.explanation: Exclude removes the member assignable to busy and leaves ready.
questions.explanationAr: Exclude بتشيل العضو المتوافق مع busy وبتسيب ready.

questions.question: Which type does Result resolve to?
questions.explanation: The function type returns boolean, which ReturnType extracts.
questions.explanationAr: نوع الدالة بيرجع boolean، وReturnType بتستخرجه.

questions.prompt: Make every property in User optional.
questions.explanation: Partial marks each property optional.
questions.explanationAr: Partial بتخلي كل خاصية اختيارية.

questions.explanation: Required removes optional property modifiers.
questions.explanationAr: Required بتشيل علامات اختيارية الخصائص.

questions.prompt: Make the properties non-reassignable through this type.
questions.explanation: Readonly applies a static readonly modifier to every property.
questions.explanationAr: Readonly بتضيف قيد readonly ثابت لكل خاصية.

questions.prompt: Keep only id and title from Book.
questions.explanation: Pick selects the requested property keys.
questions.explanationAr: Pick بتختار مفاتيح الخصائص المطلوبة.

questions.prompt: Create an object type keyed by each status with boolean values.
questions.explanation: Record maps each key in the union to the specified value type.
questions.explanationAr: Record بترابط كل مفتاح في الـ union بنوع القيمة المحدد.

questions.prompt: Extract the result type from the function declaration.
questions.explanation: ReturnType extracts a function's declared result type.
questions.explanationAr: ReturnType بتستخرج نوع نتيجة الدالة المعلن.

questions.prompt: Remove the busy literal from this union.
questions.explanation: Exclude filters out union members assignable to its second argument.
questions.explanationAr: Exclude بتستبعد أعضاء الـ union المتوافقة مع argument التاني.

questions.prompt: Keep only string members from this union.
questions.explanation: Extract keeps union members assignable to the selected type.
questions.explanationAr: Extract بتحتفظ بأعضاء الـ union المتوافقة مع النوع المحدد.

questions.question: How can Partial and Required support update workflows?
keyPoints: Partial permits updates that include only selected fields
Required can represent a complete shape
Both transform property modifiers at the type level
questions.modelAnswer: An update payload can use Partial on an object shape so callers provide only fields they intend to change. A complete persisted value can use the original or Required form when every field must be present. These utilities change static property modifiers rather than validating runtime data.
questions.explanation: Mapped utilities describe different completeness requirements for distinct API stages.
questions.explanationAr: الـ utilities بتوصف متطلبات اكتمال مختلفة في مراحل الـ API.

questions.question: When should Pick be used instead of Omit?
keyPoints: Pick is an allowlist of retained keys
Omit is a denylist of removed keys
Both preserve the selected properties' value types
questions.modelAnswer: Pick is useful when the desired public shape is a small explicit set of properties. Omit is convenient when most fields should remain and only a few are excluded. Both derive a new static object type and preserve the types of retained properties.
questions.explanation: The choice depends on whether an allowlist or a denylist better communicates intent.
questions.explanationAr: الاختيار حسب الأنسب لتوضيح النية: قائمة سماح أو قائمة استبعاد.

questions.question: Why might a library use Parameters or ReturnType?
keyPoints: They derive types from an existing callable declaration
They reduce duplicated parameter or result definitions
They stay linked as the source signature changes
questions.modelAnswer: These utilities can derive argument and result types from an existing function instead of repeating them manually. That can keep wrappers and adapters aligned with the source signature as it changes. The extracted types are static descriptions and do not call the function at runtime.
questions.explanation: Type extraction can reduce drift between related function declarations.
questions.explanationAr: استخراج الأنواع بيقلل اختلاف التعريفات المرتبطة ببعض.

questions.question: What is the difference between Exclude and Extract?
keyPoints: Exclude removes union members assignable to a target
Extract keeps union members assignable to a target
Both operate on types and do not filter runtime values
questions.modelAnswer: Exclude removes members of a union that are assignable to the selected type. Extract keeps only those matching members. Both are compile-time conditional utilities and do not inspect or filter JavaScript values at runtime.
questions.explanation: The utilities perform opposite compile-time filtering over union members.
questions.explanationAr: النوعين بيعملوا تصفية عكسية لأعضاء الـ union وقت الترجمة.
